title: oenothera cespitosa subsp. montana
intro: Oenothera cespitosa subsp. montana, commonly known as Mountain Evening Primrose, is a plant species in the evening primrose family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to offer health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera cespitosa subsp. montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
